identity_and_privacy.unknown_sender_disposition: durable rejection without raw message content or model call
identity_and_privacy.authorized_sender_disposition: raw text and source hash are durably admitted before the Living Core call
identity_and_privacy.runtime_scope: The core independently rejects a differing tenant or installation before model work.

crash_semantics.before_core_reply: The exact provider update remains unacknowledged and the core call is idempotently retried from durable ingress.
crash_semantics.processing_poison: Three identical failures produce needs_help and advance the polling cursor without an infinite loop.
crash_semantics.after_reply_before_send: The committed reply is reconstructed from PostgreSQL, then delivery is claimed.
crash_semantics.after_send_before_receipt_commit: The expired delivery claim becomes needs_help; the connector never guesses acceptance and never resends.
crash_semantics.after_receipt: The provider message ID closes the update and advances the polling offset.

The opt-in polling profile is implemented and compose-valid but is not running without a distinct Eva 2 token and reviewed identity bindings.
